name: Abishag
bio: Abishag was a beautiful young woman from Shunem brought to serve the aging King David, who could no longer keep warm; she cared for him and attended him, though David had no sexual relations with her (1 Kings 1:1-4). After David's death, Adonijah — who had briefly tried to claim the throne before Solomon's coronation — asked Bathsheba to request Abishag as his wife; Solomon took the request as a fresh bid for the throne itself and had Adonijah executed for it (1 Kings 2:13-25).
